location: src/haute/_codegen_builders.py:572-603 (_gen_constant) — specifically name default line 583 (`name = v.get("name", "col")`) and the missing skip-empty-name guard
title: _gen_constant emits columns for empty/missing-name constant entries (default name 'col'/''), diverging from the executor which skips them — generated body, generated column-contract, and in-canvas executor all disagree
description: The codegen builder for constant nodes builds the LazyFrame dict literal with `name = v.get('name', 'col')` and never skips entries whose name is empty or missing. The exec-side builder `_build_constant` (src/haute/_builders.py:610-630) does the opposite: `name = v.get('name', ''); if not name: continue`, and falls back to `{'constant': [0]}` when nothing survives. The column-contract helper `_constant_columns` (_builders.py:604-607) likewise only keeps `v.get('name')` truthy entries. So for a node whose `values` contains an entry with a missing or empty `name`, the standalone generated pipeline produces extra columns that the in-canvas executor never produces — different schema AND different values between the two execution paths, plus an internal contradiction inside the generated file itself (its body produces columns its own decorator-declared contract omits). This is the same exec/codegen semantic-divergence class as the known liveSwitch/optimiserApply/passthrough findings, but for the `constant` node type, which is not in the known list.
evidence: Generated body for values=[{'value':'5'},{'name':'','value':'7'},{'name':'ok','value':'1'}] (via real `_node_to_code`): `@pipeline.constant(config="config/constant/Params.json", contract={"inputs": [], "outputs": ['ok']})` then `return pl.LazyFrame({"col": [5.0], "": [7.0], "ok": [1.0]})`. The body yields 3 columns {col, '', ok}; the decorator contract declares outputs=['ok']; the executor `_build_constant` yields only {ok:1.0}. Executor behavior is explicitly pinned by tests/test_builder_edge_cases.py::test_value_with_empty_name_skipped (line 208, asserts result.shape[1]==1, only 'kept') and ::test_all_empty_names_produces_default (line 238, asserts result.columns==['constant']). No test pins the codegen side, and it contradicts all three.
